configurations.name: zipfelkasse
runtimeArgs: for d in "$HOME"/.elixir-install/installs/otp/*/bin "$HOME"/.elixir-install/installs/elixir/*/bin; do [ -d "$d" ] && PATH="$d:$PATH"; done; export PATH; mix ecto.create --quiet && mix ecto.migrate && exec mix phx.server

configurations.name: zipfelkasse-production-copy
runtimeArgs: for d in "$HOME"/.elixir-install/installs/otp/*/bin "$HOME"/.elixir-install/installs/elixir/*/bin; do [ -d "$d" ] && PATH="$d:$PATH"; done; export PATH; [ -f storage/preview.sqlite3 ] || install -m 600 data/prod/zipfelkasse.sqlite3 storage/preview.sqlite3; export DATABASE_PATH="$PWD/storage/preview.sqlite3" PORT=4001 YNAB_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9; mix ecto.migrate && exec mix phx.server
